title: Top Haunted Houses in US to Visit This October in Halloween - Check the Most Haunted One
excerpt: October is here, and Halloween lovers across the United States are getting ready for a month filled with creepy stories, ghost tours, haunted attractions, and plenty of scares.
content:
October is here, and Halloween lovers across the United States are getting ready for a month filled with creepy stories, ghost tours, haunted attractions, and plenty of scares. From historic homes linked to chilling legends to massive modern haunted attractions packed with actors and special effects, the US has no shortage of places for thrill-seekers.

If you're planning a spooky getaway this October, several destinations stand out. Some are famous for real-life paranormal legends, while others are professionally designed Halloween attractions. A recent 2026 guide from FrightFind highlights haunted attractions across all 50 states, while several long-running haunts continue to dominate national rankings.

So, which haunted house should make the top of your Halloween bucket list?

Winchester Mystery House – San Jose, California

The Winchester Mystery House is one of America's most famous supposedly haunted homes and arguably the best choice for visitors who want history mixed with Halloween mystery.

The enormous Victorian mansion has 160 rooms, thousands of doors and windows, winding corridors, and unusual architectural features. Construction continued for decades under Sarah Winchester, creating a building that feels almost like a maze. Its strange design and long-running ghost stories have made it one of the country's most recognizable haunted destinations.

For Halloween visitors, its unusual architecture alone makes the experience feel different from a conventional haunted attraction.

Villisca Axe Murder House – Villisca, Iowa

For those who prefer true-crime history over traditional Halloween effects, the Villisca Axe Murder House is one of the most chilling destinations in America.

The Iowa house was the scene of an unsolved 1912 murder that claimed the lives of eight people. Today, the property is associated with numerous paranormal stories and offers visitors the opportunity to explore its disturbing history.

It is certainly not a typical family Halloween attraction, but its history makes it one of the most talked-about haunted houses in the country.

Whaley House – San Diego, California

Located in San Diego's Old Town, the Whaley House combines California history with decades of ghost stories.

The property is linked to the story of Yankee Jim Robinson, who was executed on the site before the Whaley family built their home there. Visitors have reported hearing footsteps and experiencing other unexplained occurrences.

According to Travel + Leisure, the house offers daytime tours, nighttime guided experiences, and paranormal investigation opportunities.

Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum – Weston, West Virginia

The Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum is one of the most atmospheric haunted destinations in the US.

The enormous historic complex opened in the 19th century and eventually became severely overcrowded. It closed in 1994 after more than a century of operation. Today, its imposing architecture and difficult history have made it a popular destination for paranormal enthusiasts.

October is particularly popular because visitors can find ghost hunts, paranormal experiences, and flashlight tours during the spooky season.

Lizzie Borden House – Fall River, Massachusetts

The Lizzie Borden House is another destination where American history and Halloween folklore collide.

The Massachusetts property is associated with the infamous 1892 murders of Andrew and Abby Borden. Today, the historic home operates as a bed-and-breakfast and museum, attracting visitors interested in the case and its paranormal reputation.

For true-crime fans looking for an unusual October trip, this is one of the more distinctive choices.

Cutting Edge Haunted House – Fort Worth, Texas

If you're looking for a modern haunted attraction rather than a supposedly haunted historic property, Cutting Edge Haunted House is a major contender.

The Fort Worth attraction was recently named the best haunted attraction in the United States in USA Today's 2026 10Best Readers' Choice Awards. It operates inside a former meatpacking plant and delivers an immersive experience featuring live actors and elaborate effects. It has also earned multiple Guinness World Records connected to its scale.
